summary: Example [iosxr:vars] for CLI with network_cli, cisco.iosxr.iosxr, user, vaulted password and proxy command (paramiko variable deprecated in favour of libssh).
questions: What inventory variables do I need for IOS-XR over CLI?

answer_card.title: IOS-XR CLI inventory
answer_card.answer_md:
```ini
[iosxr:vars]
ansible_connection=ansible.netcommon.network_cli
ansible_network_os=cisco.iosxr.iosxr
ansible_user=myuser
ansible_password=!vault...
ansible_paramiko_proxy_command='-o ProxyCommand="ssh -W %h:%p -q bastion01"'
```
Use `ansible_libssh_proxy_command` instead of the deprecated paramiko variable. Drop the password with SSH keys and the proxy for direct access.
